about_the_game:
DISCOVER THE MUSEUM

The dark galleries of the Royal Guardian Museum are yours to explore as The Midnight Exorcist; a master of the arcane called in to investigate a deadly accident.

REVEAL MAGICAL SECRETS

Use the Exorcist’s tools to uncover the hidden depths of the Museum and the artifacts it contains. Solve puzzles and unlock new areas as you assemble the clues to the Museum’s many mysteries.

CONFRONT ANCIENT EVILS

Malevolent spirits stalk your every move as you make your way through the shadowy halls, and they do not take kindly to your presence. Avoid their traps and learn their weaknesses to eventually banish their ghost-forms and bring light and life back to the Museum.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1700 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics customization available in game to help achieve a smooth experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics customization available in game to help achieve a smooth experience.

short_description: Explore the dark corners of a haunted art museum in The Midnight Exorcist, an investigative puzzle game. Discover hidden secrets and follow the clues to piece together the ancient mystery of the museum’s past – and the ghostly dangers of its present
